# Knowledge map: Mod Loader and firmware mods

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/mods.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Mod Loader v2 in QEMU and on cameras, command items, the ILCE-6100 Picture Profile unlock and Mod Loader port, mod qualification and the external ZV-E10 adapted menu.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 10 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Entities

### <a id="mod-loader-v2"></a>Mod Loader v2

`mod.loader-v2` | module

RAM-only loader with a Mods tab, command items and hot reload, run in QEMU and on physical bodies.

Aliases: `mlv2`, `Mods tab`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 identifies its target in QEMU, accepts offline reload requests and runs real mods with hot reload in the QEMU Sony menu. ([E0575](../evidence/0575-qemu-mod-loader-v2-compatibility-boundary.md), [E0576](../evidence/0576-mod-loader-v2-reload-request.md), [E0577](../evidence/0577-qemu-real-mods-relocation-and-hot-reload.md))
- **C02** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 command items add a 'USB Streaming' style entry to the Mods tab. ([E0592](../evidence/0592-mod-loader-command-items-usb-streaming-entry.md))
- **C03** `PHYSICAL` Mod Loader v2 with RCRAW_Enable_Test.mod ran RAM-only on a physical ILCE-6400 (hooks installed, auto-on logged). ([E0633](../evidence/0633-a6400-hardware-rcraw-enable-test-live-run.md))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 was ported to the ILCE-6100 to a first milestone. ([E9103](../evidence/9103-a6100-mod-loader-port.md))
- **C06** `OFFLINE` Mods and firmware were qualified offline on 2026-11-19 without camera, SD or USB access. ([2026-11-19-firmware-qualification](../evidence/mods/2026-11-19-firmware-qualification.md))

### <a id="mod-a6100-picture-profile"></a>ILCE-6100 Picture Profile unlock

`mod.a6100-picture-profile` | module

Opt-in redirect of the Picture Profile gate on an ILCE-6100 (a6100).

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` The ILCE-6100 Picture Profile gate was located, an opt-in unlock designed and the redirect applied to a physical ILCE-6100. ([E9101](../evidence/9101-a6100-picture-profile-gate.md), [E9102](../evidence/9102-a6100-picture-profile-camera-apply.md))

### <a id="mod-zve10-adapted-menu"></a>External ZV-E10 adapted menu

`mod.zve10-adapted-menu` | module

Contributor-local adapted ZV-E10 menu in QEMU with receipts; not an upstream stock-boot milestone.

Current knowledge:

- **C07** `OFFLINE` A contributor-local adapted ZV-E10 menu runs in QEMU with English screenshots and receipts, and an upstream-board integration validation; it is not an upstream stock-boot milestone. ([README](../evidence/external-zve10-menu/README.md), [integration-validation](../evidence/external-zve10-menu/integration-validation.md))
